signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Search & Intelligence Experiences

bullets: Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for search, query, and how results are displayed and explored—grounded in analyst workflows and competitive dynamics.
Rethink interaction paradigms from first principles where the current model doesn’t serve users well.
Partner closely with engineering, design, and data science to ship capabilities that are both powerful and legible to non-technical and expert users alike.
Work with go-to-market and enablement teams to ensure new capabilities land with customers and internal stakeholders.
Make deliberate decisions about where AI adds genuine value versus where it introduces noise or erodes trust—especially critical for an audience that scrutinizes automated output.

roles.title: Product Manager, AI Agents & MCP Tools
Senior Product Manager, Digital Risk Protection Takedowns

bullets: Own the strategy and roadmap: Define the vision, priorities, and operating model for takedown capabilities within Digital Risk Protection.
Strengthen service delivery: Assess current workflows, performance, escalations, and customer pain points, then drive immediate and sustained improvements.
Scale the capability: Prioritize the highest-impact takedown types and translate complex operational requirements into scalable product workflows.
Design the operating model: Partner with Engineering and AI teams to improve validation, evidence collection, authorization, submission, monitoring, escalation, verification, and…
Establish safeguards: Work with Legal and external experts to address authorization, false positives, liability, policy requirements, and regional differences.
